name: The dynamic probe's job expiry does not outlive the sandbox cap it is meant to cover
description:
Raised by an external review of PR #84 (CZ3TDR1-735). Pre-existing on `master`, not introduced by that PR — #84 only touched the docblock that describes it, and narrowed it so it no longer reads as satisfied.

## The mechanism

`DYNAMIC_QUEUE` is created through `createEngineQueue` (`apps/worker/src/index.ts`), so its pg-boss expiry is `ENGINE_TIMEOUT_MS + 5 min` — **15 minutes** at the default `ENGINE_TIMEOUT_MS` of 600000.

The probe's own cap is not `ENGINE_TIMEOUT_MS`. `dynamic-test.ts` calls `runSandbox` without a `timeoutMs`, so the sandbox's `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS` applies (`packages/runner/src/sandbox.ts`) — also **15 minutes**. Before the sandbox starts, the job clones the repo and runs `chown` twice; after it, it copies the screenshots out.

So on the defaults the expiry equals the sandbox cap and the job's own work comes on top. A probe that runs close to its cap outlives its job, and pg-boss redelivers it while the first handler is still running — the "redelivered BECAUSE IT IS STILL ALIVE" case the comment at the queue in `index.ts` describes as the reason for the engine-length expiry. That comment reads as if the engine-length expiry closes it; on the defaults it does not, and raising `ENGINE_TIMEOUT_MS` closes it only as a side effect.

## What it costs

The queue has `retryLimit: 1`, so the redelivery spends the only retry on a job that did not fail, and a second sandbox container (Chromium + bender + webpack) starts next to the first — the thing the comment at that queue says must not pile up.

## Fix (to decide)

Size the dynamic queue's expiry from what the job actually runs — the sandbox cap plus the clone and copy around it — rather than from the engine timeout, through the expiry module #84 adds (`apps/worker/src/engine-job-expiry.ts`). Then correct the comment at `DYNAMIC_QUEUE` and the `createEngineQueue` docblock in that module.

**Done when:** the dynamic queue's expiry is derived from the sandbox cap plus the job's own work, a test pins that relation, and the comments at the queue and in `engine-job-expiry.ts` describe the rule.
